---
name: adjust-devbar-mobile-menu
description: "Use when improving the app devbar on mobile by reducing buttons, adding a dropdown menu, and keeping the same icon + text labels for buttons."
---

Update the app's devbar for a cleaner mobile experience.

- Review the current devbar layout and identify the buttons that overcrowd the mobile view.
- Group excess buttons into a compact dropdown/overflow menu.
- Preserve each button's icon and visible text label when moving it into the new menu.
- Keep the desktop/devbar behavior unchanged unless a responsive improvement is required.
- Provide the updated component structure, markup, styling, and any responsive logic needed.

If the task is unclear, ask for the specific devbar component file, the current mobile button set, and the desired grouping behavior.
